subject: Mental Models
title: Unintended Consequences
description: Learn Unintended Consequences in one minute.

hook.text: Prohibition in the 1920s was meant to stop drinking.

buildup.text: Unintended consequences are outcomes that were not foreseen by the people who made the decision.

discovery.text: Robert Merton identified five causes: ignorance, error, short-term focus, values that override analysis.

twist.text: The more complex the system, the more unintended consequences you will face. You cannot model everything in advance.

climax.text: Accept that unintended consequences are inevitable.

punchline.text: Every action has hidden results. Plan to be surprised.

quiz.question: How can you best prepare for unintended consequences?
options: Build in reversibility and actively monitor for unexpected outcomes
Analyze until all consequences are predicted
